_doc: Red families (agentctl; the owner 2026-10-29: "give all convergence red work to one agent"; simplification item 6: one long-lived owner session per family). Every open red of a family is held by ONE fixer; with "owner": true, by the family's long-lived owner (one session, one worktree, a notebook, restarted only when it dies). A red is in the FIRST family that matches: its workflow is listed or one of its failing jobs matches a `jobs` regex (Python re.search) -- when the family names any -- and its kind (test / infra / unclear) is in `kinds` -- when it names any. A red in no family is its run's own (one short-lived fixer). $AGENTCTL_RED_FAMILIES names another file.
